_comment: citation_patterns are regexes using the named groups num / author / title.
Not all three are needed. author alone is enough for matching (with lower accuracy).
[12]                          →  \[(?P<num>\d+)\]   ← numbers alone also need the reference list parsed
For a numbers-only format, it is more accurate to add the reference-list file (references.md etc.) to manuscripts
and add one more pattern that fits the entry format of that file.
threshold is the lower bound of title similarity. Raise it if matching is too loose; lower it if too many are missed.
